example: The tech giant reported record-breaking earnings for the fiscal year. (這家科技巨擘公布了創紀錄的年度盈餘。)

meaning: a. 環保的；對環境友善的
example: The factory upgraded its machinery to adopt more eco-friendly production methods. (工廠更新了機械設備，以採用更環保的生產方式。)

meaning: a. 有權享有的；符合資格的
example: All registered members are entitled to a ten percent discount on all services. (所有已註冊會員都有權享有全品項九折優惠。)
The business school offers a required course on corporate ethics and governance. (商學院開設了一門公司倫理與治理的必修課程。)

meaning: a. 有缺陷的；有瑕疵的
example: The auditor determined that the company’s financial tracking methodology was flawed. (稽核人員認定公司的財務追蹤方法有缺陷。)

meaning: n. 加盟授權方；特許經營者
example: The franchisor provides extensive training and marketing support to all new franchisees. (加盟授權方為所有新加盟業者提供完整訓練與行銷支援。)
The recent successful marketing campaign fueled a massive surge in product demand. (最近成功的行銷活動帶動產品需求大幅成長。)

meaning: a. 正常運作的；運轉中的
example: The IT department confirmed that the central server is now functioning normally again. (資訊部門確認中央伺服器現在已恢復正常運作。)
The research team received substantial funding from a government scientific grant. (研究團隊從政府科學補助中獲得了大筆經費。)
The company hosted a formal gathering to celebrate its twentieth business anniversary. (公司舉辦了一場正式聚會，慶祝成立二十週年。)

meaning: a. 有天賦的；才華出眾的
example: The research department is looking for a gifted statistician to analyze market trends. (研究部門正在尋找一位有天賦的統計學家來分析市場趨勢。)
The retail store offers a complimentary gift-wrap service during the holiday shopping season. (這家零售店在假日購物季提供免費禮品包裝服務。)
The fragile laboratory equipment requires extremely careful handling during transit. (易碎的實驗室設備在運送期間必須非常小心搬運。)
The multinational corporation decided to relocate its global headquarters to New York City. (這家跨國企業決定將全球總部遷至紐約市。)
The auditor uncovered hidden costs that were not disclosed in the initial budget. (稽核人員揭露了初始預算中未列出的隱藏成本。)
The government introduced a new affordable housing scheme for low-income workers. (政府為低收入勞工推出了新的可負擔住宅方案。)
The restaurant serves ice-cold beverages to guests upon their arrival. (餐廳在客人抵達時供應冰涼飲料。)

meaning: a. 不明智的；欠考慮的
example: Expanding the business without a clear financial plan is highly ill-advised. (沒有明確財務計畫就擴張業務是非常不明智的。)
All board members, including the chairman, voted in favor of the merger. (包括董事長在內，所有董事都投票贊成合併案。)
The consulting firm provided an in-depth analysis of current market trends. (顧問公司針對目前的市場趨勢提供了深入分析。)
Employees must remain indoors during the hazardous chemical cleanup operation outside. (外部進行危險化學品清理作業期間，員工必須留在室內。)
The injured employee was granted two weeks of paid medical leave to recover. (受傷員工獲准休兩週有薪病假以便康復。)

meaning: a. 鼓舞人心的；激勵人的
example: The CEO delivered an inspiring speech at the annual employee recognition gala. (執行長在年度員工表揚晚會上發表了鼓舞人心的演說。)
The applicant was rejected because she was lacking sufficient managerial experience. (這名申請者因缺乏足夠的管理經驗而遭到拒絕。)

meaning: a. 輕鬆自在的；不拘謹的
example: The startup maintains a laid-back workplace culture with flexible dress codes. (這家新創公司維持輕鬆自在的職場文化，服裝規定也很彈性。)
The aircraft made a safe landing despite the heavy rain and strong winds. (儘管雨勢大、風勢強，飛機仍安全降落。)
The factory is preparing for a large-scale production run of the new model. (工廠正準備大量生產這款新機型。)
Exceptional customer service helps build a lasting relationship with clients. (出色的客戶服務有助於與客戶建立持久的關係。)

meaning: a. 最後一刻的；臨時的
example: The manager made a last-minute adjustment to the presentation slides before the meeting. (經理在會議前最後一刻調整了簡報投影片。)
The committee will review the budget proposals later this afternoon. (委員會將於今天下午稍後審查預算提案。)
Our firm is a leading provider of logistics software solutions in the region. (本公司是本地區領先的物流軟體解決方案供應商。)
Due to a limited budget, we cannot afford to hire additional staff this month. (由於預算有限，我們這個月無法再聘用員工。)
Our corporate headquarters is conveniently located near the central station. (本公司的總部位置便利，就在中央車站附近。)
The global logistics firm handles the distribution of goods for major retailers. (這家全球物流公司負責大型零售商的商品配送。)
Please verify your mailing address before submitting the online order form. (提交線上訂購表單前，請確認您的郵寄地址。)
The innovative campaign gave a new meaning to sustainable advertising. (這場創新活動為永續廣告賦予了新的意義。)

meaning: n. 上午中段；上午稍晚時分
example: The supervisor scheduled a brief staff briefing for midmorning tomorrow. (主管安排明天上午中段舉行簡短的員工簡報。)
The company launched a new mid-range smartphone model to target budget consumers. (公司推出一款新的中價位智慧型手機，鎖定預算有限的消費者。)
A severe misunderstanding regarding delivery dates caused a temporary dispute with the client. (對交貨日期的嚴重誤解造成與客戶間的短暫爭議。)
She decided to pursue a career in corporate nursing to manage workplace health programs. (她決定從事企業護理工作，負責管理職場健康計畫。)

meaning: a. 有人使用的；佔用中的
example: All the conference rooms are currently occupied by the auditing team. (所有會議室目前都由稽核團隊使用中。)
Depositing toxic waste into the local river is a serious environmental offence. (將有毒廢棄物排入當地河川是嚴重的環境違法行為。)

meaning: v. 在資源上勝過；火力強於
example: The smaller firm could not outgun its rival in marketing budget or campaign reach. (這家規模較小的公司在行銷預算和宣傳觸及上都無法勝過對手。)
Operating with out-of-date software leaves the corporate network vulnerable to hacks. (使用過時的軟體會使企業網路容易遭到駭客入侵。)
The company purchased a cheap plot of land on the outskirts of the metropolitan area. (公司在都會區郊外購買了一塊價格低廉的土地。)

meaning: a. 兼職的；部分工時的
example: The retail store is looking to hire three part-time cashiers for the weekend shifts. (這家零售店正打算聘請三名兼職收銀員，負責週末班。)

meaning: abbr. 哲學博士；博士學位
example: The research laboratory hired a scientist who holds a Ph.D. in chemical engineering. (這間研究實驗室聘請了一位擁有化學工程博士學位的科學家。)
The board was highly pleased with the steady increase in quarterly revenue. (董事會對季度營收穩定成長感到非常滿意。)
The supervisor reviewed the online posting for accuracy before publishing it. (主管在發布前檢查了線上公告的正確性。)
The marketing team launched an aggressive PR campaign to improve the brand image. (行銷團隊發起積極的公關活動，以改善品牌形象。)
Smoking is strictly prohibited anywhere on the corporate premises or grounds. (公司所有場所及園區內一律嚴禁吸菸。)
Please contact the support team if you have any questions regarding your account. (如果您對帳戶有任何疑問，請聯絡支援團隊。)
The HR department is registering all employees for the upcoming safety seminar. (人資部門正在為全體員工辦理即將舉行的安全研討會報名。)

meaning: a. 著名的；享有盛譽的
example: The university optical firm is renowned for producing precision manufacturing lenses. (這家大學光學公司以製造精密加工鏡片聞名。)
The graphic designer operates as a self-employed consultant for multiple firms. (這位平面設計師以自營顧問身分為多家公司服務。)
High shipping costs can significantly reduce a retail firm's profit margins. (高昂的運費可能大幅降低零售公司的利潤率。)

meaning: a. 精密的；複雜先進的
example: The new watch model features a highly sophisticated mechanical design. (這款新手錶採用高度精密的機械設計。)
Many office employees prefer to order takeout meals during their brief lunch breaks. (許多辦公室員工喜歡在短暫的午休時間訂外帶餐點。)
The director shared a valuable thought regarding the future of AI market expansions. (主管分享了對人工智慧市場未來擴張的寶貴想法。)
The contract agreement outlines a two-sided obligation for both business partners. (合約載明雙方商業夥伴各自的義務。)

meaning: n. 打字錯誤；排印錯誤
example: A simple data entry typo caused a significant error in the final budget statement. (一個簡單的資料輸入錯字，導致最終預算報表出現重大錯誤。)
The stock market index showed a steady upwards trend throughout the afternoon session. (股市指數在整個下午交易時段都呈現穩定上升趨勢。)
The security desk issued a clear warning notice regarding data privacy policy compliance. (安全櫃檯發布了明確警告，提醒遵守資料隱私政策。)
The accountant compiled a comprehensive year-end report for the final board meeting. (會計師為最後一次董事會議彙整了一份完整的年終報告。)

meaning: v. 放大畫面；拉近檢視
example: The inspector used the zoom-in function to examine the damaged component. (檢查員使用放大功能檢查受損零件。)

meaning: v. 縮小畫面；拉遠檢視
example: The technician selected the zoom-out control to view the entire warehouse layout. (技術人員選擇縮小畫面的控制項，以檢視整個倉庫配置。)

meaning: phr. 正式舞會；慈善舞會
example: The annual ball (party) will raise funds for the hospital's new wing. (年度舞會將為醫院的新大樓募款。)
Each product is identified by a unique bar code. (每件商品都以獨一無二的條碼識別。)

meaning: phr. 附早餐的民宿；住宿加早餐旅館
example: Many business travelers prefer a bed and breakfast for short stays. (許多商務旅客短期住宿時偏好選擇附早餐的民宿。)
The film earned record revenue at the box office during its opening week. (這部電影在上映首週便創下票房收入紀錄。)
The audit team will carry out a review of the supplier's safety records. (稽核團隊將審查供應商的安全紀錄。)
Analysts predict we will come across several obstacles during the restructuring phase. (分析師預測，我們在重整階段會遇到幾項障礙。)

meaning: phr. 服裝規定；穿著規範
example: All employees must adhere to the professional dress code during office hours. (所有員工在辦公時間都必須遵守專業服裝規定。)

meaning: phr. 消防演習；火災演練
example: The building management has scheduled a mandatory fire drill for ten o'clock tomorrow. (大樓管理單位安排明天十點舉行強制消防演習。)
The human resource department is responsible for managing employee benefits. (人力資源部門負責管理員工福利。)
High quality control drives consumer trust, and vice versa. (高品質控管能提升消費者信任，反之亦然。)
